hints.title: Placement of Largest Unsorted Value
hints.text: Work backwards from the largest integer target = n down to 1, placing each number at its final sorted index.

hints.title: Two-Step Pancake Flips
hints.text: To move target to its desired position target - 1: flip from index 0 to its current position (bringing it to index 0), then flip from index 0 to target - 1.

hints.title: Prefix Reversals Sequence
hints.text: For value target from n down to 1: find index idx of target. If idx equals target - 1, continue. If idx > 0, record idx + 1 and reverse arr[:idx + 1]. Then record target and reverse arr[:target]. Return sequence of k values.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Arbitrary flips do not guarantee convergence; systematically fixing elements from largest to smallest bounds moves to <= 2 * N.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Using at most 2 * N pancake flips produces an output list within the required 10 * N limit.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should demonstrate the 2-flip strategy: flip to front, then flip to target destination.
complexity.notes: Any valid sequence of <= 10 * N flips is accepted.
